    ISF-PROCEDURES.2: inline (proc)/(call) reusable procedures (in-params)
    
    Leaf: ISF-PROCEDURES.2
    Lane: R14 (ISF — high-level language richness, theme #3)
    
    A (proc NAME (params (P (width N))...) BODY...) defines a reusable parameterized
    block; an inline (call NAME actuals...) calls it. The lightweight "callable block of
    code with its own actual arguments", realized by pure macro-expansion.
    
    Implementation (parse-time, in the adapter — the scheduler is untouched)
    - New `proc` branch in FSM::Adapter::ISF::Parser::_build_actor parses the definition
      into $actor->{procs}.
    - New pass _expand_procedure_calls (after the clause loop, before the finalizers)
      rewrites each inline (call NAME actuals) into the proc body with each in-param name
      substituted by its actual (a signal OR a whole expression). Recurses into
      when/switch/while/until/repeat bodies and the substituted body; a recursion stack
      rejects direct/transitive recursion (no hardware call stack).
    - proc/call never reach LoweringIR; the emitted .fsm is BYTE-IDENTICAL to writing the
      substituted clauses by hand (asserted in t/1390 vs a hand-written actor).
    
    Fail-closed: unknown proc, arity mismatch, recursion, handshake form (call ... as
    INST) (deferred .4), out-params (deferred .3), malformed (proc ...) (no name / no
    (params ...) / empty body). Empty (params) lisp-parse trailing-undef quirk filtered.
    
    Verified: --check-json SUCCEEDS; --verify-hdl PASS (verilator_lint + yosys_synthesis).
    
    Book: 13b "Reusable Procedures" section (4 runnable examples); 13k row; ISF_SPEC
    registers t/1390.
    
    Validation
    - prove -Iperl t/1390 (6 subtests) t/1250 t/1376 t/1305 t/1303 t/1304 t/1307 PASS.
    - identical-.fsm + when/while-body + --check-json + --verify-hdl + all fail-closed verified.
    - full ./bin/ci-regression isf --no-book PASS.
    - perl -c; mdbook build; git diff --check clean.
